title: Choose the Team & Access layout
question: Team & Access keeps the Admin Console's look; this choice is only how the area is arranged. The roll dealt three layouts. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Activity desk
options.thesis: The area opens on what happened: the audit trail is the main column, and the team is a compact rail beside it.
options.viewport: Left two-thirds: today's and yesterday's actions ("Laila suspended Karim — 10:42"), filterable by person, area and date, with Export. Right rail: Add member, counts by status, then the team; picking a person pins their card (role, scope, devices, suspend / reset / deactivate) above the rail and filters the timeline to them.
options.risk: Managing people becomes secondary to reading the feed; a long team list is squeezed into a narrow rail.

options.label: Directory by status
options.thesis: People as cards grouped by where they are: waiting for their link, active, suspended, closed.
materials: tabs for Team, Audit log, Security
options.viewport: Tabs across the top (Team · Audit log · Security). "Waiting for their setup link" first, each card showing when the link expires; then Active as a grid of cards (name, job title, Studio role, scope, 2-step mark, last active); Suspended and Deactivated folded at the bottom. Add member opens a full-page four-step flow that ends on the link.
options.risk: Cards compare people less easily than a table and grow long past forty members.

options.label: One ledger
options.thesis: One dense table of members, where each row opens in place into that person's full record.
options.viewport: Search, status filter and Add member above a table (name, role, scope, status, 2-step, last active). Opening a row expands it where it is: profile and access side by side, devices and recent sign-ins below, and the danger zone at the row's end. The audit log is a second ledger tab with the same expansion; Security is a settings sheet.
options.risk: An open row pushes the rest of the list down, and linking straight to one member needs care.

regions.label: Opened row: profile | access | devices | danger zone
